limitations: the evaluator models the six external slots as stubs; the real bcmp, memcpy, allocator and panic shims were identified by relocation and call shape, not executed
out bytes 2..7 are never written by the body and keep the caller buffer contents; the corpus compares the full 0x20 output against a 0xAA prefill
caller-side consumption of the returned index and error string is outside this body and stays with the RE-007 registration caller question
rules: the count at front+0x10 gates everything: with zero records the page product is never computed and an overflowing page is ignored
with at least one record, prod = page * 10000 is computed once under a multiply-overflow panic
records are scanned in order at a 0x20 stride from front+8; the length field at record+0x10 must equal the suffix length before bcmp compares the name bytes at record+8

the comparison covers exactly the length-field count of bytes from each pointer: a zero length compares equal against any record, and a length past a shorter stored name reads whatever follows it in memory
before the record at position p is examined, prod + p is checked for add overflow; the first unreachable position at the maximal page is 1616
a hit stores tag 0x1a2 and the global index prod + position at out+8 and returns
a miss with a negative i64 length traps through the allocation-error shim with arguments (0, len)
a zero-length miss stores tag 0x68 with cap 0, ptr 1, len 0 and allocates nothing
any other miss allocates len bytes, copies the suffix into the allocation and stores tag 0x68 with cap = len, ptr = allocation, len = len; an allocation failure traps with arguments (1, len)
both panic guards use the shared Location object for l1/src/asset/pdi.rs:32:14
